info.title: Nostro Anchor Sandbox — Public API
info.description: Stellar Testnet and PI-SPI virtual-money demonstration. Pinned official Anchor Platform 2.11.2 (a551cea2fb801d52cce2528be7e60f0620e57bfa). This is the enabled demo surface, not the complete latest SEP specification. No real funds, real FX, bank endorsement or production settlement. The public origin is a temporary demonstration tunnel; it can change or become unavailable. Responses use protocol-native formats; no mobile API envelope.

Sep10Bearer.description: Token from POST /auth. This is not a Nostro mobile token. Private keys stay outside Mintlify.

Amount.description: Decimal string. Preserve precision; do not use floating-point arithmetic.

StellarAccount.description: Public Stellar account. Never a private key.

Asset.description: SEP-38 asset identifier, including the issuer for Stellar credit assets.

type.description: Customer type, when a SEP-31 customer_info_needed error requires it.

transaction.description: Base64 XDR authentication challenge; validate and sign outside the browser.
Validated authentication challenge signed by the sending account; base64 XDR.

token.description: SEP-10 JWT. Supply as Authorization: Bearer token.

memo.description: Distinct customer reference under the sending partner; preserve as a string.

memo_type.description: Use text for the demo string memos. Omitting this can select the numeric id default.

CustomerInput.description: Demo subset of SEP-12. Provide the sending account, stable customer memo, type and fixture name on creation and update. Optionally include the existing id when updating. Accepted receiver IDs are bound to operator-configured PI-SPI sandbox aliases. The sender fixture is Demo Sender.

QuoteInput.description: Provide exactly one of sell_amount and buy_amount. Fixed demo rate only; no real FX conversion. The pinned release has different optional expiry-field handling from newer SEP-38 revisions; this demo does not expose an expiry override.

PaymentInput.description: Use an unexpired quote and accepted sender/receiver IDs. The receiver ID selects an existing sandbox alias. Amount is a decimal string in this pinned Anchor Platform implementation. A newer SEP funding_method field is not supported here.

PaymentCreated.description: Save id, then read the transaction and wait for pending_sender before funding. Destination and memo can be unavailable until preparation finishes.

Payment.description: Fields appear when available. completed is emitted only after the off-chain sandbox payout is confirmed; a Stellar transaction hash alone is not payout proof.
